Quick HSK 1 quiz 🏥

医院 (yīyuàn) is made of 医 = medicine, to heal and 院 = courtyard, institution. So what is a "healing institution"?

A) a pharmacy
B) a school
C) a hospital

Comment A, B or C 👇 Bonus: 医生 (yīshēng) is the person who works there. Can you guess what it means?

📤 Send this to someone preparing for the HSK
